t: The Essentials ATF1009 LED work light with tripod is a robust and powerful lighting solution for various professional and domestic applications. This mains-powered work light features an adjustable, twin-head design, allowing precise direction of its bright 4400 lumen output and crisp 6500K daylight colour temperature. Ideal for illuminating construction sites, workshops, or outdoor projects, its IP65 rating ensures water and dust resistance, making it suitable for demanding environments. The integrated, foldable tripod provides stable positioning and includes a cable management system for a tidy workspace. Built with an impact-resistant polycarbonate body, this durable site light offers a 40-metre beam distance and a long 35,000-hour lifespan.
